limitations: Secret-hygiene scan covers tracked files only; untracked local files are outside the gate by design (.env.local is gitignored).
Key patterns match OpenRouter (sk-or-v1-…) and NVIDIA (nvapi-…) shapes; a provider with a different key format must be added to KEY_PATTERNS.
Banned-vocabulary lint covers M33 docs and the ledger, not arbitrary source comments.
GitHub issue numbers are enforced exactly (milestone 33, issues 568–574); refiling on GitHub requires updating REAL_ISSUE_NUMBERS and the ledger together.
